name: Morimoto Leona
source: A spoiled and cruel princess of the Morimoto Conglomerate. Her famility owns St. Arcadia academy, where she is given free rein to do as she wants. Leona is a sociopath who delights in hurting and humiliating others. She is [url=https://vndb.org/c18899]Reina's[/url] younger sister.
